HasExtraCardText.rationale: Ringing.cs:8 `HasExtraCardText => true` only unlocks the UI `DynamicExtraCardText` LocString (AfflictionModel.cs:44-54). No sim reader exists or is needed; same disposition as affliction/bound's and affliction/galvanized's entries.

guards.maps_to: RingingPower.AfterApplied (RingingPower.cs:23-31) afflicts EVERY unafflicted card of ANY TYPE in the player's hand/piles at grant time (no CardType filter, unlike Galvanized/Smog/Tainted); AfterCardEnteredCombat (:33-39) afflicts one newly-entering unafflicted card; AfterSideTurnEnd (:41-47) self-removes the power (Flash + PowerCmd.Remove), whose AfterRemoved (:49-57) sweeps every Ringing affliction; ShouldPlay (:59-69) refuses to play a Ringing-carrying card once ANY card has been played by the owner this turn (a history query, not per-card). Mirrored by `power/ringing` (powers.py), already audited: rollup `faithful`, every entry closed including the ShouldPlay fix noted there. Applier confirmed ported: `sts2_rl/monsters/overgrowth/ceremonial_beast.py`.

Ringing overrides no `IsStackable`, inheriting AfflictionModel's default `False` (AfflictionModel.cs:127-130); `RingingAffliction` (afflictions.py) leaves the base `is_stackable = False` unoverridden.

Ringing is card-scoped to the player's own cards (no monster deck exists). Same single-turn shape as Bound and Entangled: RingingPower removes ITSELF at AfterSideTurnEnd, and that removal's AfterRemoved sweep is what clears every Ringing marker, so the affliction cannot outlive the turn the power was applied on. No AfterDeath override on RingingPower; it is carried by the player (enemy-inflicted), so there is no applier-death removal path to check.
